title: The Illuminated Point
shot: top-down on the map, then tilt up to KAIRO's face
camera: overhead on the map, then tilt up along the light to his face
action: The glow travels across the map and converges at one distinct point. The camera moves upward to reveal KAIRO's amazed face.
lighting: a single hot golden-blue point as the brightest thing in frame
audio: the harmonic resolves into one clear sustained note; the cave falls silent around it
dialogue_fa: یه نقطه روی نقشه روشن شد... انگار داشت یه جایی رو نشونم می‌داد. یه مقصد ناشناخته.
gloss_en: One point on the map lit up... as if it was showing me a place. An unknown destination.
continuity: the illuminated point stays in the same map position in S24
transition: his wonder motivates the decision beat of S24
image_prompt: Overhead shot of the circular amber stone map in darkness, threads of golden-blue light running along its grooves and converging into a single brilliant point on one side of the tablet. All other engravings fall dark. 2D cinematic animation, high contrast, restrained magical glow.
video_prompt: Overhead on the map as the light races along the engraved channels and pools into one bright point. The camera tilts up along the glow to KAIRO's face, lit from below, eyes wide and unblinking, mouth slightly open. The point continues to pulse softly.
